sql: select 'order' as k, market_ticker as a, status as b, cancel_reason as c, created_at::text as d from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker in ('KXCFBUNRANKEDUPSET-26W6-9','KXC4POS-26NOV03-T110') union all select 'disc', count(*)::text, min(started_at)::text, max(started_at)::text, null from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > '2026-10-07 03:00' union all select 'prog', market_ticker, start_date::text, end_date::text, period_reward_usd::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_programs where market_ticker='KXC4POS-26NOV03-T110' order by market_ticker, end_date desc) p
